description: This file defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, BinarySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, SharedSemaphore, and Event, along with related utility classes and functions, for cross-platform (Linux and Windows) use in the Thunder project.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A cross-platform class for critical section synchronization, managing mutex locking and unlocking.

classes.name: BinarySemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore with binary (locked/unlocked) state, supporting lock and unlock operations.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore that maintains a count, allowing multiple threads to acquire and release resources.

classes.name: SharedSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore that can be shared across processes, identified by a name.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: An event synchronization object supporting manual or automatic reset, wait, set, and reset operations.

classes.name: SafeSyncType
classes.description: A template class providing RAII-style locking for synchronization objects.
